required_actions: correlate at least two independent indicators
warn before one critical-room threat entry
Field-R.minimum_contribution: Create two evidence tokens from independent sources and correctly distinguish an indicator from proof.

Field-E.minimum_contribution: Keep one critical LAB_NODE in SECURE control while preventing unauthorized physical access during technical work.

Field-T.minimum_contribution: Contain credible affected scope, preserve at least one usable evidence set, and separately validate one restored critical function.

nodes.description: Build an initial incident picture from independent evidence.
Contain high-risk affected services without unnecessary outage.
Restore and validate one trusted critical function.
Extract the team with stabilized or sealed mission state.

stages.player_reasoning: Compare time, source quality, and independence of multiple incident indicators rather than treating every alert as proof.
Group assets into likely affected, possibly affected, and currently unsupported-by-evidence categories.
Revise the hypothesis after new evidence and confirm whether the scope remains supported.

dependencies: Field-R may spend AP to create evidence tokens that remove unsupported interpretations
wrong_path_consequences: Overscoping reduces SERVICE_HEALTH through unnecessary isolation
Underscoping leaves a hidden affected asset active
Treating rumor as proof caps SCOPE_CONFIDENCE until corrected
lab_nodes.validation: A second independent evidence source or later system behavior must support the selected incident-scope hypothesis.
lab_nodes.battlefield_effect: Higher scope confidence reveals the correct primary service target and prevents a later hidden degradation event.

stages.player_reasoning: Classify fictional account states using evidence rather than assuming password-only equals compromised or MFA equals invulnerable.
Remove high-confidence suspect access while preserving a trusted administrative path required for response continuity.
Confirm legitimate critical staff can still authenticate and suspect session paths are no longer active.

dependencies: Field-E CONTROL of Z-C prevents interruption during identity validation
wrong_path_consequences: Disabling every identity path lowers SERVICE_HEALTH
Leaving a high-confidence suspect path active can re-degrade restored service
lab_nodes.validation: Trusted critical access must work after suspect access is removed; both conditions are required.
lab_nodes.battlefield_effect: Successful identity validation prevents confused building security from escalating against the squad and unlocks safer service restoration.

stages.player_reasoning: Trace the fictional service dependency graph and distinguish critical, suspect, and currently trusted paths.
Select containment scope that limits credible spread while preserving clean critical dependencies where evidence supports doing so.
Commit the chosen containment plan while accepting the tactical cost of anchoring Field-T at the node.
Confirm suspicious behavior stopped and required unaffected service paths remain usable.

dependencies: Field-R evidence tokens improve path characterization
Field-E Protected Window protects the anchored commit stage
wrong_path_consequences: Too-narrow containment leaves a residual path
lab_nodes.validation: Both containment effect and preserved critical-service behavior must be observed after commit.
lab_nodes.battlefield_effect: Verified containment disables one hostile door-control behavior and reduces later reinforcement timing by one round.

stages.player_reasoning: Choose the evidence set that best supports incident scope under limited time and storage without collecting unrelated private bulk data.
Preserve the chosen fictional evidence set while accepting a full-turn technical commitment.
Verify the preserved set matches the recorded source state using abstract integrity values and documented provenance.

dependencies: Field-E SECURE control permits maximum EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY
CONTESTED control caps evidence integrity below maximum
wrong_path_consequences: Over-collection consumes WINDOW and raises privacy EXPOSURE
Skipping verification yields weaker debrief confidence
lab_nodes.validation: Preserved artifact verification values and provenance record must agree with the captured source state.
lab_nodes.battlefield_effect: Sealed evidence enables the strongest scope findings, preserves Jordan's story evidence option, and improves debrief authority.

stages.player_reasoning: Inspect fictional vendor inventory and maintenance context without assuming third-party involvement proves causation.
Compare vendor-linked state against independent incident evidence before promoting it into the compromise scope.

dependencies: Timeline evidence determines whether vendor context increases scope confidence
wrong_path_consequences: Assuming vendor equals attacker produces an attribution-bias debrief flag and unnecessary isolation risk
lab_nodes.validation: Vendor relevance counts only when at least one independent mission evidence source supports the relationship.
lab_nodes.battlefield_effect: Correctly correlated vendor context reveals one hidden dependency edge at the primary service node.

stages.player_reasoning: Identify a physical access artifact as a relevant clue while keeping its meaning provisional.
Secure and document the fictional physical clue after Field-E controls the tile, preserving provenance under tactical pressure.

dependencies: Field-E must make the clue tile SECURE for maximum integrity
wrong_path_consequences: Casual pickup during contact lowers evidence integrity but does not erase the clue
lab_nodes.validation: The physical artifact becomes evidentiary only when its time/location/provenance is documented and correlated with other incident evidence.
lab_nodes.battlefield_effect: Preserved physical evidence improves incident chronology and may reveal a threat approach earlier.

threat_schedule.lab_or_board_effect: Field-R must choose between evidence work and overwatch/pursuit.

threat_schedule.trigger: Vendor clue discovered and Evidence Room unsecured
threat_schedule.lab_or_board_effect: R warning can buy E one repositioning round.

kinetic_coupling.kinetic_action_or_state: Gunfire through marked rack lanes in Z-D
kinetic_coupling.technical_effect: Raises Detection and risks visible equipment-state degradation that adds a recovery/validation step.
kinetic_coupling.technical_success_back_effect: Verified containment can disable one hostile door-control behavior and reduce reinforcement timing.

kinetic_coupling.kinetic_action_or_state: Field-E suppression or Hold in a technical room
kinetic_coupling.technical_effect: Can preserve CONTROL and protect a fragile or anchored Field-T stage without requiring threat elimination.
kinetic_coupling.technical_success_back_effect: Restored trusted identity state can prevent armed security from escalating against the squad.

kinetic_coupling.kinetic_action_or_state: Field-R spends both AP on Overwatch/repositioning
kinetic_coupling.technical_effect: External lane is protected but no evidence token is produced that round, potentially increasing T lab cost.
kinetic_coupling.technical_success_back_effect: Improved incident telemetry can reveal an approach marker and strengthen R Picture.

telemetry_required: combat actions that altered lab state
technical actions that altered battlefield state

operational_scoring.objective: Score containment quality, defensible scope, trusted restoration, and optional protected notification/story evidence.
operational_scoring.team: Score operator/civilian safety, injuries, downs, and extraction state.
operational_scoring.exposure: Score Detection peak, public-hall gunfire, unauthorized evidence-room access, and response-driven privacy disclosure.
operational_scoring.integrity: Score evidence integrity, authorization boundaries, preservation before destructive recovery, and completed validation.
operational_scoring.time: Score remaining Window/Extract time while preserving the anti-binary partial-success rules.

acceptance_tests: Player uses cover/shooting/overwatch/suppression in the same mission as substantive incident-response labs.
At least one shooting decision changes technical risk or state.
At least one technical success changes tactical board state.
Field-R information materially changes a Field-T lab decision or AP cost.
Field-E Control materially protects a Field-T fragile or anchored stage.
Field-T must reason about evidence and dependencies rather than press a generic hack button.
A wrong technical choice creates an observable causal consequence and remains recoverable in normal play.
Validation is a distinct action from configuration/containment.
Window expiration transitions to extract with partial work rather than a binary fail banner.
Debrief can identify specific mastered/missed concepts and link back to lyric cues.
No live target, real credential, or actionable external intrusion procedure is required.
Mission remains entertaining if optional full lesson pages are never opened.
